sendReviewInvite.description: Sends a review invite to your customer.

email.description: The email of the customer to send the invite to (required if Phone Number is empty)

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the customer to send the invite to (required if Email is empty)

inviteDelayDays.description: The number of days to delay the invite (i.e send after X days)

salesRepEmail.description: The email of the sales rep to associate the review and customer

aiMetadata.description: Sends a Cloutly review-invitation to a customer via email and/or SMS, scoped to a specific business and review campaign. Use to solicit a review from a customer after a purchase or interaction. Requires businessId and campaignId, plus at least one of email or phone number to deliver the invite; an optional delay defers sending by N days. Not idempotent — each call dispatches a new invite.
